examples.chinese: 今天下午學校有籃球比賽，我們去看吧！
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān xiàwǔ xuéxiào yǒu lánqiú bǐsài, wǒmen qù kàn ba!
examples.english: There is a basketball game at school this afternoon. Let’s go watch it!

examples.chinese: 你要參加學校的游泳比賽嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào cānjiā xuéxiào de yóuyǒng bǐsài ma?
examples.english: Are you going to participate in the school's swimming competition?

examples.chinese: 華人用十二生肖代表每一年。他常常代表學校去參加游泳比賽，所以在學校非常有名。
examples.pinyin: Huárén yòng shí'èr shēngxiào dàibiǎo měi yì nián. Tā chángcháng dàibiǎo xuéxiào qù cānjiā yóuyǒng bǐsài, suǒyǐ zài xuéxiào fēicháng yǒumíng.
examples.english: Chinese people use the twelve zodiac signs to represent each year. He often represents the school to participate in swimming competitions, so he is very famous at school.

examples.chinese: 他跑得很快，如果跟他比賽，我沒有機會贏，一定會輸。
examples.pinyin: Tā pǎo de hěn kuài, rúguǒ gēn tā bǐsài, wǒ méiyǒu jīhuì yíng, yīdìng huì shū.
examples.english: He runs very fast; if I compete with him, I have no chance of winning—I will definitely lose.

examples.chinese: 我只參加過籃球比賽，其他運動比賽我都沒有經驗。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhǐ cānjiāguo lánqiú bǐsài, qítā yùndòng bǐsài wǒ dōu méiyǒu jīngyàn.
examples.english: I have only participated in basketball competitions; I have no experience in other sports competitions.

examples.chinese: 大華為了參加唱歌比賽，除了每天不斷地練習，也把自己唱的歌錄下來聽一聽，希望能唱得更好。雖然陸先生這幾年工作機會不斷，但是因為身體不好的關係一直沒辦法去上班。
examples.pinyin: Dàhuá wèile cānjiā chànggē bǐsài, chúle měitiān bùduàn de liànxí, yě bǎ zìjǐ chàng de gē lù xiàlái tīng yī tīng, xīwàng néng chàng de gèng hǎo. Suīrán Lù xiānsheng zhè jǐ nián gōngzuò jīhuì bùduàn, dànshì yīnwèi shēntǐ bù hǎo de guānxi yīzhí méi bànfǎ qù shàngbān.
examples.english: In order to participate in the singing competition, Dahua not only practices continuously every day, but also records his own singing to listen to, hoping to sing better. Although Mr. Lu has had continuous job opportunities these past few years, because of poor health he has never been able to go to work.

examples.chinese: 小安現在的健康情況很差，就算很想參加網球比賽，恐怕也贏不了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo'ān xiànzài de jiànkāng qíngkuàng hěn chà, jiùsuàn hěn xiǎng cānjiā wǎngqiú bǐsài, kǒngpà yě yíng bùliǎo.
examples.english: Xiao'an's current health condition is very poor. Even if he really wants to participate in the tennis match, I'm afraid he won't be able to win.

examples.chinese: 媽媽替我報名了亞洲鋼琴比賽，她說只要我肯努力，一定會有好成績的。
examples.pinyin: Māma tì wǒ bàomíngle Yàzhōu gāngqín bǐsài, tā shuō zhǐyào wǒ kěn nǔlì, yīdìng huì yǒu hǎo chéngjī de.
examples.english: My mother signed me up for the Asian Piano Competition. She said that as long as I am willing to work hard, I will definitely get good results.

examples.chinese: 我們的足球教練認為，比賽前跑步是必要的訓練，從明天起每天得跑一個小時。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de zúqiú jiàoliàn rènwéi, bǐsài qián pǎobù shì bìyào de xùnliàn, cóng míngtiān qǐ měitiān děi pǎo yī ge xiǎoshí.
examples.english: Our soccer coach believes that running before a game is necessary training; starting tomorrow, we have to run for an hour every day.

examples.chinese: 張先生滑雪的技巧很好，這次比賽他有信心能夠得到前三名。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng huáxuě de jìqiǎo hěn hǎo, zhè cì bǐsài tā yǒu xìnxīn nénggòu dédào qián sān míng.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang's skiing skills are very good; for this competition, he has confidence that he can get into the top three.

examples.chinese: 小畢本來認為自己的書法寫得很好，但是上次比賽輸了以後，他就失去自信了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Bì běnlái rènwéi zìjǐ de shūfǎ xiě de hěn hǎo, dànshì shàng cì bǐsài shū le yǐhòu, tā jiù shīqù zìxìn le.
examples.english: Xiǎo Bì originally thought his calligraphy was very good, but after losing the last competition, he lost his self-confidence.

examples.chinese: 小李第一次參加釣魚比賽就得了第一名，真是幸運。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lǐ dì-yī cì cānjiā diàoyú bǐsài jiù dé le dì-yī míng, zhēn shì xìngyùn.
examples.english: Little Li got first place the first time he participated in a fishing competition; he is really lucky.

examples.chinese: 黃先生的腳因為車禍受了很嚴重的傷，醫生建議他不要做太激烈的運動。這場網球比賽打得很激烈，已經打了五個小時了，還不知道誰輸誰贏。
examples.pinyin: Huáng xiānsheng de jiǎo yīnwèi chēhuò shòule hěn yánzhòng de shāng, yīshēng jiànyì tā búyào zuò tài jīliè de yùndòng. Zhè chǎng wǎngqiú bǐsài dǎ de hěn jīliè, yǐjīng dǎle wǔ ge xiǎoshí le, hái bù zhīdào shéi shū shéi yíng.
examples.english: Mr. Huang's foot was seriously injured in a car accident; the doctor advised him not to do overly intense exercise. This tennis match is being played very fiercely; it has already been played for five hours, and it is still unknown who will lose and who will win.

examples.chinese: 你們之間的誤會越來越深，要是不面對面說清楚，恐怕連朋友都當不成了。下課以後，老師幫我一對一補習數學，希望我的期末考會及格。昨天的歐洲足球賽，法國對義大利的比賽真是太刺激了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐmen zhījiān de wùhuì yuè lái yuè shēn, yàobùshì miànduìmiàn shuō qīngchǔ, kǒngpà lián péngyǒu dōu dāng bù chéng le. Xiàkè yǐhòu, lǎoshī bāng wǒ yī duì yī bǔxí shùxué, xīwàng wǒ de qīmòkǎo huì jígé. Zuótiān de Ōuzhōu zúqiúsài, Fǎguó duì Yìdàlì de bǐsài zhēn shì tài cìjī le.
examples.english: The misunderstanding between you two is getting deeper and deeper; if you don't talk it out face to face, I'm afraid you won't even be able to remain friends. After class, the teacher helped me with one-on-one math tutoring, hoping I will pass the final exam. Yesterday's European football match, France versus Italy, was really too exciting.

examples.chinese: 昨天棒球賽進行到一半時突然下起了大雨，雖然後來雨停了，但因為球場太溼，也無法繼續比賽了。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān bàngqiúsài jìnxíng dào yíbàn shí tūrán xià qǐ le dàyǔ, suīrán hòulái yǔ tíng le, dàn yīnwèi qiúchǎng tài shī, yě wúfǎ jìxù bǐsài le.
examples.english: Yesterday, when the baseball game had proceeded to halfway, it suddenly started raining heavily. Although the rain stopped later, because the field was too wet, the game could not continue.

items.wordHook: 比(compare) + 賽(compete) → comparing and competing is a 比賽, a competition.

examples.chinese: 我想先換衣服再去運動。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng xiān huàn yīfu zài qù yùndòng.
examples.english: I want to change clothes first and then go exercise.

examples.chinese: 我只參加過籃球比賽，其他運動比賽我都沒有經驗。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhǐ cānjiāguo lánqiú bǐsài, qítā yùndòng bǐsài wǒ dōu méiyǒu jīngyàn.
examples.english: I have only participated in basketball competitions; I have no experience in other sports competitions.

examples.chinese: 元宵節燈會是華人新年的重要活動。
examples.pinyin: Yuánxiāojié dēnghuì shì Huárén xīnnián de zhòngyào huódòng.
examples.english: The Lantern Festival Lantern Carnival is an important event for Chinese New Year.

examples.chinese: 明天我要跟朋友去參加跨年活動，我還沒跟父母講這件事。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān wǒ yào gēn péngyǒu qù cānjiā kuànián huódòng, wǒ hái méi gēn fùmǔ jiǎng zhè jiàn shì.
examples.english: Tomorrow I'm going with friends to attend a New Year's Eve event; I still haven't talked to my parents about this.

examples.chinese: 華人和日本人都有十二生肖，十二生肖的動物也一樣嗎？
examples.pinyin: Huárén hé Rìběnrén dōu yǒu shí'èr shēngxiào, shí'èr shēngxiào de dòngwù yě yíyàng ma?
examples.english: Chinese people and Japanese people both have the twelve zodiac signs; are the animals of the twelve zodiac signs also the same?

examples.chinese: 她很喜歡小動物，想要有一隻小狗。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn xǐhuān xiǎo dòngwù, xiǎng yào yǒu yì zhī xiǎo gǒu.
examples.english: She likes small animals very much and wants to have a little dog.

examples.chinese: 每天早上公園裡都有很多人在運動，非常熱鬧。
examples.pinyin: Měitiān zǎoshang gōngyuán lǐ dōu yǒu hěn duō rén zài yùndòng, fēicháng rènao.
examples.english: Every morning in the park there are many people exercising, it is very lively.

examples.chinese: 你參加過什麼有趣的新年活動？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ cānjiā guò shénme yǒuqù de xīnnián huódòng?
examples.english: What interesting New Year activities have you participated in?

examples.chinese: 來台灣以後，每個週末我都有很多活動，覺得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Lái Táiwān yǐhòu, měi ge zhōumò wǒ dōu yǒu hěn duō huódòng, juéde hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: After coming to Taiwan, I have many activities every weekend and feel very happy.

examples.chinese: A:昨天你去運動了嗎 ？ B:我沒去運動，我去朋友家玩。
examples.pinyin: A: Zuótiān nǐ qù yùndòng le ma? B: Wǒ méi qù yùndòng, wǒ qù péngyou jiā wán.
examples.english: A: Did you go exercise yesterday? B: I didn't go exercise; I went to a friend's house to have fun.

examples.chinese: 我最近太胖了，應該多運動，少吃一點飯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuìjìn tài pàng le, yīnggāi duō yùndòng, shǎo chī yīdiǎn fàn.
examples.english: I've gotten too fat recently; I should exercise more and eat a little less food.

examples.chinese: 最近天氣比較熱，我不常去運動。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn tiānqì bǐjiào rè, wǒ bù cháng qù yùndòng.
examples.english: Recently the weather is relatively hot, so I don't often go exercise.

examples.chinese: 我的興趣是運動，打網球、游泳，我都喜歡。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de xìngqù shì yùndòng, dǎ wǎngqiú, yóuyǒng, wǒ dōu xǐhuān.
examples.english: My hobby is doing exercise. I like both tennis and swimming.

examples.chinese: 我每天早上七點去學校運動。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān zǎoshang qī diǎn qù xuéxiào yùndòng.
examples.english: I go to school to exercise at 7:00 every morning.

examples.chinese: 我們下個星期要學第十五課，我剛才先看了一點兒，書上有很多種動物，我覺得很有意思。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xià ge xīngqí yào xué dì shíwǔ kè, wǒ gāngcái xiān kàn le yìdiǎnr, shū shàng yǒu hěn duō zhǒng dòngwù, wǒ juéde hěn yǒuyìsi.
examples.english: We are going to learn lesson fifteen next week. I previewed a bit earlier just now. There are many kinds of animals in the book; I think it is very interesting.

examples.chinese: 有哪些動物？
examples.pinyin: Yǒu nǎxiē dòngwù?
examples.english: What animals are there in the book?

examples.chinese: 華人用不一樣的動物代表每一年，一共有十二種動物。
examples.pinyin: Huárén yòng bù yíyàng de dòngwù dàibiǎo měi yì nián, yígòng yǒu shí'èr zhǒng dòngwù.
examples.english: Chinese use different animals to represent each year, and there are a total of twelve kinds of animals.

examples.chinese: 我平常坐紅線去學校上課，週末也坐捷運去運動、看電影。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ píngcháng zuò hóng xiàn qù xuéxiào shàngkè, zhōumò yě zuò jiéyùn qù yùndòng, kàn diànyǐng.
examples.english: I usually go to school by the red one. On weekends I take it to exercise or see a movie as well.

examples.chinese: 你不要常常在家上網、看電腦、玩手機，應該去運動。明天我有空，我們可以一起去騎腳踏車。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ búyào chángcháng zài jiā shàngwǎng, kàn diànnǎo, wán shǒujī, yīnggāi qù yùndòng. Míngtiān wǒ yǒukòng, wǒmen kěyǐ yìqǐ qù qí jiǎotàchē.
examples.english: Don’t surf the internet, use the computer or play on the cell phone at home often. You should go exercise. I am available tomorrow. We can go ride bikes together.

examples.chinese: A:醫生說我應該多運動，少吃太鹹、太油的東西，這樣才不容易生病。 B:就是說嘛！我跟你說過好多次了，你怎麼不聽呢？
examples.pinyin: A: Yīshēng shuō wǒ yīnggāi duō yùndòng, shǎo chī tài xián, tài yóu de dōngxi, zhèyàng cái bù róngyì shēngbìng. B: Jiùshì shuō ma! Wǒ gēn nǐ shuō guò hǎo duō cì le, nǐ zěnme bù tīng ne?
examples.english: A: The doctor said I should exercise more and eat less of things that are too salty or too oily; this way it's not easy to get sick. B: Exactly! I've told you many times, why don't you listen?

examples.chinese: 這整條街都是賣體育用品的店，只要來這裡就能買到想要的運動鞋。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhěng tiáo jiē dōu shì mài tǐyù yòngpǐn de diàn, zhǐyào lái zhèlǐ jiù néng mǎi dào xiǎng yào de yùndòng xié.
examples.english: This entire street is full of stores selling sports supplies; as long as you come here, you can buy the athletic shoes you want.

examples.chinese: 像踢足球那樣的運動，對年紀大的人不太合適。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng tī zúqiú nàyàng de yùndòng, duì niánjì dà de rén bù tài héshì.
examples.english: Sports like playing soccer are not very suitable for older people.

examples.chinese: 超商常舉辦送小禮物或買一送一的活動，可是對王先生完全沒有吸引力。
examples.pinyin: Chāoshāng cháng jǔbàn sòng xiǎo lǐwù huò mǎi yī sòng yī de huódòng, kěshì duì Wáng xiānsheng wánquán méiyǒu xīyǐnlì.
examples.english: Convenience stores often hold promotions giving small gifts or buy-one-get-one-free, but they have completely no appeal to Mr. Wang.

examples.chinese: 付錢的時候，他從皮包裡抽出一張信用卡交給店員。他參加百貨公司的活動，抽到一台價格六萬元的平板電腦， 真是太幸運了！
examples.pinyin: Fù qián de shíhou, tā cóng píbāo lǐ chōu chū yī zhāng xìnyòngkǎ jiāo gěi diànyuán. Tā cānjiā bǎihuò gōngsī de huódòng, chōu dào yī tái jiàgé liù wàn yuán de píngbǎn diànnǎo, zhēn shì tài xìngyùn le!
examples.english: When paying, he took out a credit card from his wallet and handed it to the clerk. He participated in a department store event and drew a tablet computer worth 60,000 yuan; he was really so lucky!

examples.chinese: 強烈的陽光對我們的眼睛不好，出門活動時最好戴上太陽眼鏡。
examples.pinyin: Qiángliè de yángguāng duì wǒmen de yǎnjing bù hǎo, chūmén huódòng shí zuìhǎo dài shàng tàiyáng yǎnjìng.
examples.english: Strong sunlight is bad for our eyes; when going out for activities, it's best to wear sunglasses.

examples.chinese: 因為停電了，想要知道颱風的消息，只能聽收音機的廣播。這個活動會場有服務中心，想找人的話，可以請服務人員廣播。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi tíngdiàn le, xiǎng yào zhīdào táifēng de xiāoxi, zhǐ néng tīng shōuyīnjī de guǎngbō. Zhège huódòng huìchǎng yǒu fúwù zhōngxīn, xiǎng zhǎo rén de huà, kěyǐ qǐng fúwù rényuán guǎngbō.
examples.english: Because the power is out, if you want to know news about the typhoon, you can only listen to the radio broadcast. There is a service center at this event venue; if you want to find someone, you can ask the service staff to make an announcement.

examples.chinese: 世界運動會的規模很大，每回舉辦時，五大洲的國家都會來參加。
examples.pinyin: Shìjiè Yùndònghuì de guīmó hěn dà, měi huí jǔbàn shí, wǔ dà zhōu de guójiā dōu huì lái cānjiā.
examples.english: The scale of the World Games is very large; each time it is held, countries from five continents come to participate.

examples.chinese: 那場強烈地震發生以後，許多國家的專業人員都來救災，讓人非常感動。
examples.pinyin: Nà chǎng qiángliè dìzhèn fāshēng yǐhòu, xǔduō guójiā de zhuānyè rényuán dōu lái jiùzāi, ràng rén fēicháng gǎndòng.
examples.english: After that strong earthquake occurred, professionals from many countries came to provide disaster relief, which was very moving.

examples.chinese: 九二一大地震時，臺灣人發揮了互相幫助的精神，讓人非常感動。
examples.pinyin: Jiǔ'èr yī dà dìzhèn shí, Táiwān rén fāhuī le hùxiāng bāngzhù de jīngshén, ràng rén fēicháng gǎndòng.
examples.english: During the 921 earthquake, Taiwanese people brought out the spirit of helping one another, which was very moving.

examples.chinese: 我最喜歡的休閒活動是爬山和露營。為了身體和心理的健康，就算再忙，假日也應該休閒一下。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐhuān de xiūxián huódòng shì páshān hé lùyíng. Wèile shēntǐ hé xīnlǐ de jiànkāng, jiùsuàn zài máng, jiàrì yě yīnggāi xiūxián yīxià.
examples.english: My favorite leisure activities are mountain climbing and camping. For the sake of physical and mental health, even if you're busy, you should still take some leisure time on holidays.

examples.chinese: 這次社區的中秋節活動，決定在戶外舉辦，萬一下雨了就搬到室內去。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shèqū de Zhōngqiūjié huódòng, juédìng zài hùwài jǔbàn, wànyī xià yǔ le jiù bān dào shìnèi qù.
examples.english: This community Mid-Autumn Festival event has been decided to be held outdoors; if it rains, it will be moved indoors.

examples.chinese: 王老闆舉辦了一個免費吃鬆餅的活動，目的是調查哪種口味的鬆餅最受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Wáng lǎobǎn jǔbàn le yīgè miǎnfèi chī sōngbǐng de huódòng, mùdì shì diàochá nǎ zhǒng kǒuwèi de sōngbǐng zuì shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: Boss Wang held an event with free waffles; the purpose was to investigate which flavor of waffle is most popular.

examples.chinese: 大地震過後才幾天，這個災區的民眾除了收到許多衣服和食物，還收到五千萬元，讓大家又驚訝又感動。
examples.pinyin: Dà dìzhèn guòhòu cái jǐ tiān, zhège zāiqū de mínzhòng chúle shōudào xǔduō yīfu hé shíwù, hái shōudào wǔqiān wàn yuán, ràng dàjiā yòu jīngyà yòu gǎndòng.
examples.english: Only a few days after the major earthquake, the people in this disaster area not only received many clothes and food, but also received fifty million dollars, which made everyone both surprised and moved.

examples.chinese: 滑雪是很刺激的活動，需要很好的技巧。李小姐受不了離婚的刺激，已經好幾天吃不好、睡不好了。
examples.pinyin: Huáxuě shì hěn cìjī de huódòng, xūyào hěn hǎo de jìqiǎo. Lǐ xiǎojiě shòu bù liǎo líhūn de cìjī, yǐjīng hǎo jǐ tiān chī bù hǎo, shuì bù hǎo le.
examples.english: Skiing is a very exciting activity that requires good skills. Miss Li couldn't handle the shock of divorce, and has been unable to eat or sleep well for several days.

examples.chinese: 既然你那麼喜歡張小姐，就應該主動一點，約她去看電影、吃個飯什麼的。
examples.pinyin: Jìrán nǐ nàme xǐhuān Zhāng xiǎojiě, jiù yīnggāi zhǔdòng yīdiǎn, yuē tā qù kàn diànyǐng, chī ge fàn shénme de.
examples.english: Since you like Miss Zhang so much, you should take the initiative a bit more—ask her out to a movie, a meal, or something.

examples.chinese: 那家動物餐廳的空間很大，可以讓客人的小動物自由自在地活動。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā dòngwù cāntīng de kōngjiān hěn dà, kěyǐ ràng kèrén de xiǎo dòngwù zìyóuzìzài de huódòng.
examples.english: That animal restaurant has a lot of space, allowing guests' small pets to move around freely and fancy-free.

examples.chinese: 小溫規劃的旅遊行程，有參觀、購物、看表演等活動，我相信大家會很滿意。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Wēn guīhuà de lǚyóu xíngchéng, yǒu cānguān, gòuwù, kàn biǎoyǎn děng huódòng, wǒ xiāngxìn dàjiā huì hěn mǎnyì.
examples.english: The travel itinerary planned by Xiao Wen includes activities such as sightseeing, shopping, and watching performances; I believe everyone will be very satisfied.

examples.chinese: 現在突然下起了大雨，我們的計畫被破壞了，恐怕今天所有的活動都必須重新安排。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài tūrán xià qǐ le dàyǔ, wǒmen de jìhuà bèi pòhuài le, kǒngpà jīntiān suǒyǒu de huódòng dōu bìxū chóngxīn ānpái.
examples.english: Now it has suddenly started raining heavily, and our plans have been ruined; I'm afraid all of today's activities must be rearranged anew.

examples.chinese: 他參加了服務社團的活動後，生活比過去更豐富、更有意義。
examples.pinyin: Tā cānjiā le fúwù shètuán de huódòng hòu, shēnghuó bǐ guòqù gèng fēngfù, gèng yǒu yìyì.
examples.english: After he participated in the service club's activities, his life has become richer and more meaningful than in the past.

examples.chinese: 發生大地震後，民眾都發揮愛心，主動提供救災的相關用品給災民。
examples.pinyin: Fāshēng dà dìzhèn hòu, mínzhòng dōu fāhuī àixīn, zhǔdòng tígōng jiùzāi de xiāngguān yòngpǐn gěi zāimín.
examples.english: After the major earthquake, people showed compassion and proactively provided disaster-relief related supplies to the victims.

examples.chinese: 記者說參加這次慢跑活動的人數已經超過了一百人，可是我數來數去只有五十幾個。
examples.pinyin: Jìzhě shuō cānjiā zhè cì mànpǎo huódòng de rénshù yǐjīng chāoguò le yìbǎi rén, kěshì wǒ shǔ lái shǔ qù zhǐyǒu wǔshí jǐ ge.
examples.english: The reporter said the number of people participating in this jogging event has already exceeded one hundred, but I counted and counted and there were only fifty-some.

examples.chinese: 在所有的同事中，我覺得小周最好相處了。他的性格開朗、說話幽默，還常主動幫忙，跟他相處起來很愉快、很自在。
examples.pinyin: Zài suǒyǒu de tóngshì zhōng, wǒ juéde Xiǎo Zhōu zuì hǎo xiāngchǔ le. Tā de xìnggé kāilǎng, shuōhuà yōumò, hái cháng zhǔdòng bāngmáng, gēn tā xiāngchǔ qǐlái hěn yúkuài, hěn zìzài.
examples.english: Among all my colleagues, I think Xiao Zhou is the easiest to get along with. He has a cheerful personality, speaks humorously, and often offers help proactively; getting along with him is very pleasant and relaxed.

examples.chinese: 像衝浪、滑雪那樣的戶外活動，又刺激又好玩，不用說，絕對能吸引青少年。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng chōnglàng, huáxuě nàyàng de hùwài huódòng, yòu cìjī yòu hǎowán, bùyòng shuō, juéduì néng xīyǐn qīngshàonián.
examples.english: Outdoor activities like surfing and skiing are both exciting and fun; needless to say, they can definitely attract teenagers.

examples.chinese: 有人說發生大地震以前，小動物會亂跑、亂叫，這是很自然的現象。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén shuō fāshēng dà dìzhèn yǐqián, xiǎo dòngwù huì luàn pǎo, luàn jiào, zhè shì hěn zìrán de xiànxiàng.
examples.english: Some people say that before a major earthquake occurs, small animals will run around and make noise; this is a very natural phenomenon.

examples.chinese: 這次的露營活動因為颱風辦不成了，可以說計畫永遠沒辦法趕上變化。張老闆開會開得太久，沒趕上飛機，只好花錢再買一張機票了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de lùyíng huódòng yīnwèi táifēng bàn bù chéng le, kěyǐ shuō jìhuà yǒngyuǎn méi bànfǎ gǎnshàng biànhuà. Zhāng lǎobǎn kāihuì kāi de tài jiǔ, méi gǎnshàng fēijī, zhǐhǎo huā qián zài mǎi yī zhāng jīpiào le.
examples.english: This camping activity couldn't be held because of the typhoon; you could say that plans can never catch up with changes. Boss Zhang's meeting went on too long, and he didn't catch the plane, so he had no choice but to spend money to buy another ticket.

examples.chinese: 在華語中心，每個學期老師都會帶領學生參加戶外教學的活動。
examples.pinyin: Zài Huáyǔ zhōngxīn, měi ge xuéqī lǎoshī dōu huì dàilǐng xuéshēng cānjiā hùwài jiàoxué de huódòng.
examples.english: At the Chinese language center, every semester the teacher leads students to participate in outdoor teaching activities.

examples.chinese: 這個牌子的運動服在夜市賣五百元，可是在百貨公司賣兩千元，你覺得合理嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zhège páizi de yùndòngfú zài yèshì mài wǔbǎi yuán, kěshì zài bǎihuò gōngsī mài liǎngqiān yuán, nǐ juéde hélǐ ma?
examples.english: This brand of sportswear sells for five hundred yuan at the night market, but sells for two thousand yuan at the department store—do you think that's reasonable?

examples.chinese: 當人們生活水準提高，開始重視生活品質時，休閒活動也就跟著多了起來。
examples.pinyin: Dāng rénmen shēnghuó shuǐzhǔn tígāo, kāishǐ zhòngshì shēnghuó pǐnzhí shí, xiūxián huódòng yě jiù gēnzhe duō le qǐlái.
examples.english: When people's standard of living rises and they begin to value quality of life, leisure activities then increase accordingly.

examples.chinese: 我覺得減少工作，增加有意義的休閒活動，這樣的生活比較充實。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde jiǎnshǎo gōngzuò, zēngjiā yǒu yìyì de xiūxián huódòng, zhèyàng de shēnghuó bǐjiào chōngshí.
examples.english: I think reducing work and increasing meaningful leisure activities—this kind of life is more fulfilling.

examples.chinese: 大雄從小個性就很被動，別人要求的事他才做，父母跟老師都希望他可以主動一點。
examples.pinyin: Dàxióng cóngxiǎo gèxìng jiù hěn bèidòng, biérén yāoqiú de shì tā cái zuò, fùmǔ gēn lǎoshī dōu xīwàng tā kěyǐ zhǔdòng yīdiǎn.
examples.english: Daxiong has been passive in personality since childhood; he only does things when others ask him to. His parents and teachers all hope he can be a bit more proactive.

examples.chinese: 在學習中文的期間，小林下課後除了複習功課，也和同學參加了不少社團活動。
examples.pinyin: Zài xuéxí Zhōngwén de qījiān, Xiǎo Lín xiàkè hòu chúle fùxí gōngkè, yě hé tóngxué cānjiā le bùshǎo shètuán huódòng.
examples.english: During the period of studying Chinese, after class Xiao Lin not only reviewed his lessons but also participated in quite a few club activities with classmates.

examples.chinese: 黃先生的腳因為車禍受了很嚴重的傷，醫生建議他不要做太激烈的運動。這場網球比賽打得很激烈，已經打了五個小時了，還不知道誰輸誰贏。
examples.pinyin: Huáng xiānsheng de jiǎo yīnwèi chēhuò shòule hěn yánzhòng de shāng, yīshēng jiànyì tā búyào zuò tài jīliè de yùndòng. Zhè chǎng wǎngqiú bǐsài dǎ de hěn jīliè, yǐjīng dǎle wǔ ge xiǎoshí le, hái bù zhīdào shéi shū shéi yíng.
examples.english: Mr. Huang's foot was seriously injured in a car accident; the doctor advised him not to do overly intense exercise. This tennis match is being played very fiercely; it has already been played for five hours, and it is still unknown who will lose and who will win.

examples.chinese: 這部電影是用真實故事拍成的，讓觀眾感覺很真實，也很感動。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng shì yòng zhēnshí gùshì pāi chéng de, ràng guānzhòng gǎnjué hěn zhēnshí, yě hěn gǎndòng.
examples.english: This movie was made based on a real story, making the audience feel it is very real and also very moved.

examples.chinese: 你知道第一次世界運動會是在哪裡舉行的嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào dì yī cì shìjiè yùndònghuì shì zài nǎlǐ jǔxíng de ma?
examples.english: Do you know where the first World Games were held?

examples.chinese: 這次亞洲文化展，除了樂器表演，還有傳統服裝試穿活動，歡迎各位來參觀。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì Yàzhōu wénhuà zhǎn, chúle yuèqì biǎoyǎn, hái yǒu chuántǒng fúzhuāng shìchuān huódòng, huānyíng gèwèi lái cānguān.
examples.english: This Asian Culture Exhibition, in addition to musical instrument performances, also has traditional clothing try-on activities; everyone is welcome to visit.

examples.chinese: A:為什麼活動中心連一個人都沒有？今天不是有吉他社的表演嗎？ B:你搞錯了，演出日期是下個星期三。
examples.pinyin: A: Wèishénme huódòng zhōngxīn lián yí ge rén dōu méiyǒu? Jīntiān bú shì yǒu jítā shè de biǎoyǎn ma? B: Nǐ gǎo cuò le, yǎnchū rìqī shì xià ge xīngqīsān.
examples.english: A: Why is there not a single person at the activity center? Isn't there a guitar club performance today? B: You got it wrong; the performance date is next Wednesday.

examples.chinese: 這次世界運動會的一百公尺賽跑，美國運動員跑出了九點三七秒的新記錄。老師把學生每次考試的分數記錄下來，這樣就能知道學生是不是進步了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shìjiè yùndònghuì de yībǎi gōngchǐ sàipǎo, Měiguó yùndòngyuán pǎochū le jiǔ diǎn sān qī miǎo de xīn jìlù. Lǎoshī bǎ xuéshēng měi cì kǎoshì de fēnshù jìlù xiàlái, zhèyàng jiù néng zhīdào xuéshēng shì bù shì jìnbù le.
examples.english: In this World Games 100-meter race, the American athlete set a new record of 9.37 seconds. The teacher records the students' scores for each exam, so that it can be known whether the students have improved.

examples.chinese: 那家店的門是自動的，只要站到門前就會自動打開。這棟大樓有安全系統的設備，小偷進去就會自動發出警告的聲音通知警察。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn de mén shì zìdòng de, zhǐyào zhàn dào mén qián jiù huì zìdòng dǎkāi. Zhè dòng dàlóu yǒu ānquán xìtǒng de shèbèi, xiǎotōu jìnqù jiù huì zìdòng fāchū jǐnggào de shēngyīn tōngzhī jǐngchá.
examples.english: The door of that shop is automatic; as soon as you stand in front of the door, it will open automatically. This building has safety system equipment; if a thief enters, it will automatically emit a warning sound to notify the police.

examples.chinese: 紀先生的部落格擁有不少讀者，下個週末他要辦一場新書活動，買了新書的讀者都可以請他簽名。
examples.pinyin: Jì xiānsheng de bùluògé yōngyǒu bùshǎo dúzhě, xià gè zhōumò tā yào bàn yī chǎng xīnshū huódòng, mǎi le xīnshū de dúzhě dōu kěyǐ qǐng tā qiānmíng.
examples.english: Mr. Ji's blog has quite a few readers; next weekend he will hold a new book event, and readers who have bought the new book can ask him for an autograph.

examples.chinese: 他努力了三年，終於考上了最好的大學，他激動得流下了眼淚。
examples.pinyin: Tā nǔlì le sān nián, zhōngyú kǎoshàng le zuì hǎo de dàxué, tā jīdòng de liú xià le yǎnlèi.
examples.english: He worked hard for three years and finally got into the best university; he was so excited that he shed tears.

examples.chinese: 在真實世界中沒有「龍」這種動物，那只是古人的想像。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhēnshí shìjiè zhōng méiyǒu “lóng” zhè zhǒng dòngwù, nà zhǐshì gǔrén de xiǎngxiàng.
examples.english: In the real world, there is no such animal as a "dragon"; that is only the imagination of ancient people.

examples.chinese: 我男朋友親手做了一張卡片，還買了一個漂亮的背包送給我， 他的心意讓我很感動。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ nánpéngyou qīnshǒu zuò le yì zhāng kǎpiàn, hái mǎi le yí ge piàoliang de bēibāo sòng gěi wǒ, tā de xīnyì ràng wǒ hěn gǎndòng.
examples.english: My boyfriend personally made a card and also bought a beautiful backpack to give me; his kindly feelings moved me very much.

examples.chinese: 學校蓋了一棟活動中心，學生又多了一個交流、休閒的好場所了。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào gài le yī dòng huódòng zhōngxīn, xuéshēng yòu duō le yī gè jiāoliú, xiūxián de hǎo chǎngsuǒ le.
examples.english: The school has built an activity center; the students now have one more good place for interaction and leisure.

examples.chinese: 那位畫家的作品十分生動，畫裡的人物好像真的能從畫裡走出來一樣。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi huàjiā de zuòpǐn shífēn shēngdòng, huà lǐ de rénwù hǎoxiàng zhēn de néng cóng huà lǐ zǒu chūlái yīyàng.
examples.english: That painter's works are extremely vivid; the figures in the paintings seem as if they could really walk out of the paintings.

examples.chinese: 一大早就有不少民眾在寺廟前的廣場上運動。
examples.pinyin: Yī dàzǎo jiù yǒu bùshǎo mínzhòng zài sìmiào qián de guǎngchǎng shàng yùndòng.
examples.english: Early in the morning, quite a few people are already exercising in the square in front of the temple.

examples.chinese: 小偷：我又沒偷東西，為什麼抓我？ 警察：你先別動，只要看了商店攝影機錄下來的內容，就知道事實了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎotōu: Wǒ yòu méi tōu dōngxi, wèishénme zhuā wǒ? Jǐngchá: Nǐ xiān bié dòng, zhǐyào kàn le shāngdiàn shèyǐngjī lù xiàlái de nèiróng, jiù zhīdào shìshí le.
examples.english: Thief: I didn't steal anything, why are you arresting me? Police: Don't move first; as long as you look at what the store's camera recorded, you'll know the fact.

examples.chinese: 這本書有豐富的內容及生動的鉛筆畫，是吸引讀者購買的主要原因。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū yǒu fēngfù de nèiróng jí shēngdòng de qiānbǐhuà, shì xīyǐn dúzhě gòumǎi de zhǔyào yuányīn.
examples.english: This book has rich content and lively pencil drawings, which are the main reasons that attract readers to buy it.

examples.chinese: 他為了演好健身教練的角色，透過運動與調整飲食，讓身體維持在最佳的狀態。
examples.pinyin: Tā wèile yǎn hǎo jiànshēn jiàoliàn de juésè, tòuguò yùndòng yǔ tiáozhěng yǐnshí, ràng shēntǐ wéichí zài zuìjiā de zhuàngtài.
examples.english: In order to play the role of a fitness coach well, he keeps his body in the best condition through exercise and diet adjustment.

examples.chinese: 想要讓身體健康，得先注意飲食，少吃太油、太鹹的食物；其次要培養每天運動的好習慣。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng yào ràng shēntǐ jiànkāng, děi xiān zhùyì yǐnshí, shǎo chī tài yóu, tài xián de shíwù; qícì yào péiyǎng měitiān yùndòng de hǎo xíguàn.
examples.english: If you want to be healthy, you must first pay attention to your diet and eat less greasy and salty food; secondly, you need to cultivate the good habit of exercising every day.

examples.chinese: 想要身體健康，最有效的方法就是多運動、少吃甜點、多吃蔬菜水果。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng yào shēntǐ jiànkāng, zuì yǒuxiào de fāngfǎ jiùshì duō yùndòng, shǎo chī tiándiǎn, duō chī shūcài shuǐguǒ.
examples.english: If you want to be healthy, the most effective way is to exercise more, eat fewer sweets, and eat more vegetables and fruit.

examples.chinese: 當鄰居生活遇到困難時，老馬總是主動提供協助，真令人感動。
examples.pinyin: Dāng línjū shēnghuó yùdào kùnnán shí, Lǎo Mǎ zǒngshì zhǔdòng tígōng xiézhù, zhēn lìng rén gǎndòng.
examples.english: When neighbors encounter difficulties in life, Old Ma always proactively offers assistance; it truly makes one moved.

examples.chinese: 儘管這次推銷新產品的活動辦得很順利，顧客的反應也很好，不過還是有需要改進的地方。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn zhè cì tuīxiāo xīn chǎnpǐn de huódòng bàn de hěn shùnlì, gùkè de fǎnyìng yě hěn hǎo, bùguò háishì yǒu xūyào gǎijìn de dìfāng.
examples.english: Although this event to promote the new product went very smoothly and customers' reactions were also very good, there are still areas that need improvement.

examples.chinese: 「教師節」這個節日是為了紀念偉大的孔子。
examples.pinyin: 「Jiàoshī Jié」 zhège jiérì shì wèile jìniàn wěidà de Kǒngzǐ.
examples.english: The holiday "Teachers' Day" is for commemorating the great Confucius.

examples.chinese: 大寶明年有去英國留學的打算，所以找了家庭教師幫他補習， 希望提高英文程度。
examples.pinyin: Dàbǎo míngnián yǒu qù Yīngguó liúxué de dǎsuàn, suǒyǐ zhǎo le jiātíng jiàoshī bāng tā bǔxí, xīwàng tígāo Yīngwén chéngdù.
examples.english: Dabao plans to study abroad in the UK next year, so he found a private tutor to help him with cram tutoring, hoping to improve his English level.

examples.chinese: 孔子不僅是中國偉大教師的代表，他的教育和哲學思想，對華人的影響也很大。
examples.pinyin: Kǒngzǐ bùjǐn shì Zhōngguó wěidà jiàoshī de dàibiǎo, tā de jiàoyù hé zhéxué sīxiǎng, duì Huárén de yǐngxiàng yě hěn dà.
examples.english: Confucius is not only a representative of China's great teachers, but his educational and philosophical thoughts have also had a great influence on Chinese people.

examples.chinese: 如果想當語言教師，得先考取教師證書，將來找工作較順利。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ xiǎng dāng yǔyán jiàoshī, děi xiān kǎoqǔ jiàoshī zhèngshū, jiānglái zhǎo gōngzuò jiào shùnlì.
examples.english: If you want to be a language teacher, you must first pass the exam to obtain a teaching certificate; then finding a job in the future will be smoother.

items.key: ["B3L10-1-01","健康检查","健康檢查/健檢","健康检查/健检","N"]

examples.chinese: 公司向每位員工發出健檢通知，上面寫著檢查時間、地點和需要注意的事情。地震救災人員聽到東邊大約五公尺以外的地方，有人發出求救的聲音，就立刻趕過去救人。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī xiàng měi wèi yuángōng fāchū jiànjiǎn tōngzhī, shàngmiàn xiě zhe jiǎnchá shíjiān, dìdiǎn hé xūyào zhùyì de shìqíng. Dìzhèn jiùzāi rényuán tīngdào dōngbiān dàyuē wǔ gōngchǐ yǐwài de dìfāng, yǒu rén fāchū qiújiù de shēngyīn, jiù lìkè gǎn guòqù jiù rén.
examples.english: The company sent out a health check notice to every employee, with the examination time, location, and matters needing attention written on it. Earthquake rescue workers heard someone send out a cry for help from a place about five meters to the east, so they immediately rushed over to rescue the person.

examples.chinese: 這家公司福利不錯，每年除了提供免費健檢，老闆還會帶員工出國旅遊。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī fúlì búcuò, měinián chúle tígōng miǎnfèi jiànjiǎn, lǎobǎn hái huì dài yuángōng chūguó lǚyóu.
examples.english: This company's benefits are quite good; every year, in addition to providing free health checkups, the boss also takes the employees on overseas trips.

examples.chinese: 現代企業越來越重視員工的福利和健康，例如提供免費的旅遊和健檢。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài qǐyè yuèláiyuè zhòngshì yuángōng de fúlì hé jiànkāng, lìrú tígōng miǎnfèi de lǚyóu hé jiànjiǎn.
examples.english: Modern enterprises increasingly value employee benefits and health, for example, providing free travel and health checkups.

examples.chinese: A:要是你發現男朋友對你越來越冷淡，還常跟女網友約會， 你會原諒他嗎？ B:這麼花心的男人，絕對不值得原諒。
examples.pinyin: A: Yàoshi nǐ fāxiàn nánpéngyou duì nǐ yuèláiyuè lěngdàn, hái cháng gēn nǚ wǎngyǒu yuēhuì, nǐ huì yuánliàng tā ma? B: Zhème huāxīn de nánrén, juéduì bù zhídé yuánliàng.
examples.english: A: If you found out that your boyfriend was becoming colder and colder toward you and often went on dates with female internet friends, would you forgive him? B: A man who is such a playboy is absolutely not worth forgiving.

examples.chinese: 外國人在臺灣生活期間，如果遇到任何問題，都可以打0800-024111，請求協助。那個壞人殺了人，他知道自己錯了，到教堂去請求上帝原諒。
examples.pinyin: 1. Wàiguórén zài Táiwān shēnghuó qījiān, rúguǒ yùdào rènhé wèntí, dōu kěyǐ dǎ 0800-024111, qǐngqiú xiézhù. 2. Nàge huàirén shā le rén, tā zhīdào zìjǐ cuò le, dào jiàotáng qù qǐngqiú Shàngdì yuánliàng.
examples.english: 1. During their time living in Taiwan, if foreigners encounter any problems, they can call 0800-024111 to request assistance. 2. That bad person killed someone; he knew he was wrong and went to church to beg God for forgiveness.

examples.chinese: A:犯錯的人都可以請求原諒嗎？ B:得看他犯的是什麼錯，要是小小的錯，就該原諒吧。
examples.pinyin: A: Fàncuò de rén dōu kěyǐ qǐngqiú yuánliàng ma? B: Děi kàn tā fàn de shì shénme cuò, yàoshi xiǎoxiǎo de cuò, jiù gāi yuánliàng ba.
examples.english: A: Can everyone who makes a mistake ask for forgiveness? B: It depends on what mistake he made; if it's a small mistake, then he should be forgiven.

examples.chinese: 他跟我道歉時一點兒誠意都沒有，所以我不會原諒他。
examples.pinyin: Tā gēn wǒ dàoqiàn shí yìdiǎnr chéngyì dōu méiyǒu, suǒyǐ wǒ bú huì yuánliàng tā.
examples.english: When he apologized to me, he didn't have even a bit of sincerity, so I won't forgive him.

items.wordHook: Combining 原(source) and 諒(excuse): 原諒 means forgive.

examples.chinese: 科學家發明了電燈，改變了人類的生活方式，也大大提高了生活品質。網路是很偉大的發明，就算不出門，也能讓人們得到全球各地的訊息。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā fāmíng le diàndēng, gǎibiàn le rénlèi de shēnghuó fāngshì, yě dàdà tígāo le shēnghuó pǐnzhí. Wǎnglù shì hěn wěidà de fāmíng, jiùsuàn bù chūmén, yě néng ràng rénmen dédào quánqiú gèdì de xùnxí.
examples.english: Scientists invented the electric light, which changed the lifestyle of mankind and also greatly improved the quality of life. The Internet is a great invention; even without going out, it can let people get information from all over the world.

examples.chinese: 理論上，有空氣、水、食物就可以維持生命，但還是得看實際的情況。著名的科學家愛因斯坦（ Àiyīnsītǎn, Albert Einstein）發明了相對論（Theory of Relativity），這個理論對後來的科學研究產生了重大的影響。
examples.pinyin: Lǐlùn shàng, yǒu kōngqì, shuǐ, shíwù jiù kěyǐ wéichí shēngmìng, dàn háishì děi kàn shíjì de qíngkuàng. Zhùmíng de kēxuéjiā Àiyīnsītǎn fāmíng le xiāngduìlùn, zhège lǐlùn duì hòulái de kēxué yánjiū chǎnshēng le zhòngdà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: In theory, with air, water, and food, life can be maintained, but it still depends on the actual situation. The famous scientist Albert Einstein developed the theory of relativity; this theory had a major impact on later scientific research.

examples.chinese: 他靠自己的力量，經過了十年，終於完成了這個發明。
examples.pinyin: Tā kào zìjǐ de lìliàng, jīngguò le shí nián, zhōngyú wánchéng le zhège fāmíng.
examples.english: Relying on his own strength, after ten years, he finally completed this invention.

examples.chinese: 人們為了節省勞力，發明了許多實用的機械。
examples.pinyin: Rénmen wèile jiéshěng láolì, fāmíng le xǔduō shíyòng de jīxiè.
examples.english: In order to save labor, people invented many practical machines.

examples.chinese: 這項新發明解決了許多環保問題，發明的人還受國家表揚。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiàng xīn fāmíng jiějué le xǔduō huánbǎo wèntí, fāmíng de rén hái shòu guójiā biǎoyáng.
examples.english: This new invention solved many environmental problems, and the inventor was even praised by the country.

items.wordHook: Combining 發(distribute) and 明(bright): 發明 means invent.

examples.chinese: 臺灣的超商有店到店的送貨服務，不但速度快，運費也不貴。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de chāoshāng yǒu diàn dào diàn de sònghuò fúwù, bùdàn sùdù kuài, yùnfèi yě bù guì.
examples.english: Convenience stores in Taiwan offer store-to-store delivery service; not only is it fast, but the shipping fee is also inexpensive.

examples.chinese: 我去英國留學時，常利用週末到旅行社打工，帶觀光客到著名的景點觀光。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qù Yīngguó liúxué shí, cháng lìyòng zhōumò dào lǚxíngshè dǎgōng, dài guānguāngkè dào zhùmíng de jǐngdiǎn guānguāng.
examples.english: When I studied abroad in the UK, I often used weekends to work part-time at a travel agency, taking tourists sightseeing to famous attractions.

examples.chinese: 觀光客都說日本四季的景色都很有特色，有機會我要親自去體驗一下。
examples.pinyin: Guānguāngkè dōu shuō Rìběn sìjì de jǐngsè dōu hěn yǒu tèsè, yǒu jīhuì wǒ yào qīnzì qù tǐyàn yíxià.
examples.english: Tourists all say that Japan's scenery in all four seasons is very distinctive; if I have the chance, I want to experience it for myself.

examples.chinese: 有些國家為了吸引更多的觀光客來旅遊，就把一些出境、入境的手續改簡單了。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē guójiā wèi le xīyǐn gèng duō de guānguāngkè lái lǚyóu, jiù bǎ yìxiē chūjìng, rùjìng de shǒuxù gǎi jiǎndān le.
examples.english: Some countries, in order to attract more tourists to travel, have simplified some exit and entry procedures.

examples.chinese: 本地社區的房子常被好奇的觀光客破壞，令人們十分不滿。
examples.pinyin: Běndì shèqū de fángzi cháng bèi hàoqí de guānguāngkè pòhuài, lìng rénmen shífēn bùmǎn.
examples.english: Houses in the local community are often damaged by curious tourists, which makes people very dissatisfied.

examples.chinese: 花蓮太魯閣的確很漂亮，難怪每年都吸引許多觀光客去參觀。
examples.pinyin: Huālián Tàilǔgé dequè hěn piàoliang, nánguài měinián dōu xīyǐn xǔduō guānguāngkè qù cānguān.
examples.english: Hualien's Taroko Gorge is indeed very beautiful; no wonder it attracts many tourists to visit every year.

examples.chinese: 我的電腦系統無法升級，所以很多功能都不能使用。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de diànnǎo xìtǒng wúfǎ shēngjí, suǒyǐ hěn duō gōngnéng dōu bùnéng shǐyòng.
examples.english: My computer system cannot be upgraded, so many functions cannot be used.

items.wordHook: Clearly 不(not) possessing 過(pass): 不過 means but, however.
A person 亻(person) standing beside an elephant 象(elephant) is a striking picture 像(picture).
Stepping forward to 出(go out) and contribute all your physical 力(strength): 出力 means share one's strength or power.
已(already) + 經(pass through) → already passed through, so it's already done.
Combining 樂(music) and 趣(interest): 樂趣 means pleasure, enjoyment, joy.
Combining 紅(red) and 豆(beans): 紅豆 means red bean.
Combining 親(relatives) and 手(hand): 親手 means with one's own hands.
